name: brace-expansion
description: Compatibility shim: brace-expansion 5.0.8 behaviour behind the callable CommonJS API that minimatch@3 still expects. See README.md.
comment: brace-expansion-upstream (npm:brace-expansion@5.0.8) is declared in the ROOT package.json devDependencies, not here. Declaring it here would make this package depend on the very name the root `overrides` block redirects to this package, which npm resolves as a cycle and silently skips. This directory lives inside the repo, so Node resolves brace-expansion-upstream by walking up to the root node_modules.
